185: Total-correlation synchronization is a classical information/statistical measure applied to SEEG and oscillator simulations; no actual AI learning/inference role is established.
189: Homophily/heterophily spatial-temporal GCN branches learn dynamic road interactions for traffic-flow forecasting on real transport datasets.
190: Actor-critic neural reinforcement learning estimates optimal control for nonlinear multi-agent actuators with faults and saturation, coupled to engineering tracking/stability constraints.
196: Delayed-feedback oscillators physically emulate classical multiplex dynamical networks and wave/resonance phenomena; neural-computing motivation does not establish an implemented AI research method.
201: The abstract proposes cognitive-development stages and a conceptual insectoid symbolic-agent account; actual AI experiments that investigate human development are not established. Preserve this evidence limitation rather than infer neuroscience from cognitive language.
202: A trained intra/inter-channel CNN and dynamic label smoothing analyze real multichannel physiological datasets, addressing biosignal feature extraction and cross-domain generalization.
205: Periodic dynamic graph convolution/recurrent decoding uses learned road periodicity and changing traffic interactions for real traffic-flow prediction.
206: A learned progressive prompt encoder/decrypter and calibration framework performs3D interactive medical segmentation while preserving anatomy and reducing user interactions.
216: Adaptive dynamic learning neural dynamics directly solve equality-constrained time-varying quadratic programs, with error-driven parameters, convergence/robustness theory and numerical solutions.
220: An encoder-decoder/ViT attention network preserves tiny infrared target contours and locations under sensor downsampling, addressing a concrete infrared sensing task.
224: Chaotic adaptive whale swarm optimization tunes a fractional grey/Markov model to predict measured asphalt-pavement roughness and structural performance using RIOHtrack data.
226: Cross-modal delayed knowledge transfer and spiking representations decode continuous EEG attention, with a new experimental audiovisual-EEG dataset and analyses of stimulus rhythm and neural delays.
234: Online XGBoost/self-attention LSTM ensemble weights and uncertainty updates predict real wind-farm power under nonstationary weather/generation dynamics.
242: The abstract addresses generic policy-gradient training failures in simulated soft-barrier agent environments without identifying a substantive scientific system or domain-control contribution.
247: A network estimates entropy-regularized optimal-transport matrices instead of Sinkhorn and is used for robust OT/barycenters. Need verify that this is actual learned neural inference rather than rewriting classical iterations inside a network graph.
258: Small-target saliency, low-confidence filtering and FC-to-CNN distillation learn hyperspectral anomalies for Earth-observation sensing rather than generic object classification.
259: Dynamic GCN channel consistency and self-contrast learning train semi-supervised segmentation on actual medical-image datasets.
260: The title explicitly says neural prescribed-performance control, but the supplied abstract details adaptive switching/backstepping laws without stating the actual neural approximator. Need necessary method evidence before promotion.
266: A latent autoencoder and learned energy-based style translation remove non-biological multi-site MRI effects, with3984-subject training and travelling-subject validation including tissue segmentation.
268: A diffusion model generates minority cyber-intrusion traffic representations and a dual-attention residual network detects network attacks, directly addressing communication-network security under traffic imbalance.
272: Accelerated quadratic-penalty differential/primal-dual optimization is classical mathematics; an actual neural AI solver or learned inference role is not described.
276: Spatial/temporal gated MLPs explicitly model traffic periodicity and distribution shifts to forecast actual road flows.
279: Cross-attention and GCN fuse brain-region fMRI with genetic SNP networks for Alzheimer diagnosis and identification of high-risk regions/genes.
281: Neural approximators estimate target dynamics and matched/unmatched disturbances for robust physical multi-agent enclosing control without expensive higher-order sensors.
289: A substantive survey of519 code-model papers plus CodeBERT/CodeGPT/CodeT5 experiments on bug fixing/detection/search/summarization. Existing AI methods are clearly analyzed, but parent should decide whether generic software-model performance qualifies as AI4S under this project's software-tool boundary.
290: Calibrated heterogeneous whole-brain dynamical models investigate fMRI/gene-expression/network criticality. Need confirm an actual learned AI method rather than ordinary biophysical oscillator calibration.
292: Dynamic-position parameter transfer and global/local style augmentation improve unseen-domain segmentation of retinal, prostate and spinal-cord medical images.
293: The actual method described is a distributed primal-dual/diffusion optimization algorithm; neurodynamic motivation alone does not establish an implemented AI method.
294: Reservoir computing decodes experimental neuronal-culture electrophysiology to reconstruct connectivity and predict responses to localized optogenetic stimulation.
295: A learned dynamic graph and spectral/temporal attention CNN decode emotional EEG and select relevant channels, with self-collected neurophysiological data.
301: A decomposition-based dynamic neural solver directly optimizes constrained Markowitz risk/profit portfolios with transaction costs, convergence theory and real-stock numerical experiments.
309: Context-aware encoder and recurrent multi-object semantic fusion perform semi-supervised ultrasound segmentation under limited medical labels.
310: Causal confounder/intervention modules and multimodal trajectory feedback improve instruction-conditioned physical-environment navigation in R2R/REVERIE/RxR.
327: Overparameterized deep Ritz convergence is analyzed specifically for second-order elliptic PDEs with Robin boundaries, providing scientific-neural-solver guarantees rather than generic neural capacity bounds.
336: Joint-attention multimodal networks integrate CT images and clinical text for intracerebral-hemorrhage prognosis, with in-house/public clinical cohorts.
337: Swarm-optimized multi-support-vector models learn dissolved-gas transformer faults using IEC-TC10 and additional power-equipment data.
339: A smooth-gradient neural dynamical solver handles nonsmooth nonconvex constrained optimization, including matrix condition-number optimization, with convergence and numerical evidence.
346: Frequency-feature/logit knowledge distillation transfers long-EEG information to short-EEG students for SSVEP BCI physiological decoding.
352: A hybrid spiking transformer extracts pulse/heart/respiration physiology through camera remote photoplethysmography, validated on four real rPPG datasets.
368: A learned voxel-attention/sparse3D-convolution detector addresses sparse vehicle LiDAR returns and small pedestrians/bicycles in autonomous-driving sensing.
370: Dynamic visual prompts adapt pretrained Transformers to actual medical classification and segmentation with limited labeled images.
375: Independent subspace/contrastive learning is a generic multi-view classification method; spatial information here is feature geometry, not a confirmed scientific spatial-data application.
381: Knowledge tracing models evolving logical/grammatical programming skills from students' repeated coding behavior and skill graphs, directly studying educational assessment/learning states.
396: Diffusion equations analyze multiscale neural-network training errors and spectral bias. Mathematics/physics is used to analyze AI itself, not an implemented AI solving a scientific PDE problem.
397: Background-centric attention is specifically designed for small, fast UAV detection under sensing/resource limitations and tested on drone datasets.
399: The abstract develops a general visual anomaly hypothesis-testing/score framework without identifying a concrete scientific or industrial sensing problem; no domain contribution is assumed from unstated benchmarks.
3: Learned sound-source direction classification is tailored to continuous angular sensing: unbiased label distributions and adjacent decoding directly reduce physical direction-of-arrival quantization errors.
6: Multi-attention UNet segments thyroid nodules in ultrasound, with multi-centre experiments at17 hospitals and federated privacy-preserving learning.
9: The actual soft underwater propulsor is used as a physical recurrent reservoir and predicts hydrodynamic thrust from actuation/kinematic readouts, addressing soft-vehicle state estimation beyond generic reservoir benchmarks.
14: Multimodal conversational emotion recognition is a generic representation/fusion benchmark on IEMOCAP/MELD; no scientific human-behavior investigation is established by the abstract.
19: Artificial vision and vision-language networks predict human categorical-colour data and dissect task-dependent visual/linguistic influences on perception, with an explicit cognitive-neuroscience question.
29: Autoencoders disentangle common and individual BOLD/connectome components in HCP fMRI, validate new sessions/subjects and investigate hemispheric/cognitive-behavior differences.
39: Identifiable variational autoencoders recover nonlinear nonstationary spatiotemporal sources; the meteorological application estimates and interprets latent components and improves forecasts.
46: A neurodynamic optimization model based on an augmented Lagrangian directly solves distributed nonconvex constrained mathematical optimization, with stability/optimality analysis and numerical solutions.
47: Monkey V4 and human figure-ground responses are examined through contour measurements, correlations and ordinary multiple linear regression; no actual learned AI method is identified in the abstract.
56: Deep transfer learning fuses near-field millimetre-wave and visible images for penetrating nondestructive internal-defect detection/localization under obstruction.
58: An optimized attention/multiscale CNN performs morphological identification of bone-marrow cancer cell images with task-specific training/evaluation.
62: Underwater rectangling/enhancement is a concrete imaging problem, but the described procedures are mesh warping, complementary geometric optimization and parameter-adaptive channel/fusion correction; an implemented learned AI role is not established. Do not infer AI merely from attentive weights or comparisons to deep learning.
64: BiLSTM-Filt learns radar-word pulse-train structures for segmentation and recognition under corrupted electromagnetic environments and unknown radar words.
73: Quality-driven LSTM and autoencoder distinguish quality-related industrial process faults, evaluated using dynamic simulations and the Tennessee Eastman process.
74: Information-bottleneck multimodal networks diagnose obstructive sleep apnea from large real-world home sleep-test signals and compare diagnostic modality combinations.
81: Transformer substructure embeddings and CNN interactions predict drug-side-effect frequencies, including novel drugs, addressing pharmacological risk assessment.
93: A periodically complete crystal-graph representation and message-passing PerCNet predict actual crystal material properties with proof of unique periodic representation and material-dataset tests.
103: An experimentally validated EEG-neural-decoding protocol jointly tunes processing/model hyperparameters and multi-seed reliability across204 participants, MI/P300/SSVEP datasets.
111: Adaptive dynamic programming uses critic neural networks to approximate Hamilton-Jacobi costs for safe modular-robot manipulator control under disturbances, with simulations and experiments.
112: The abstract proves a mathematical propagation property of insect-inspired STMD computational models. It does not establish a learned/inferential AI method materially used for a separate scientific task; the neural model itself is the mathematical object.
128: MIU-Net multi-scale/dual-attention and focal loss segment the optic disc for pathological-myopia assessment using actual retinal datasets.
130: Memristive reservoir hardware is tested on generic spoken-digit and Mackey-Glass benchmarks; physical hardware for AI is not itself evidence of AI used for a material/physical scientific investigation.
133: Sparse Bayesian correntropy learning reconstructs real muscle activity from noisy brain recordings using two brain modalities, directly addressing physiological BCI decoding.
135: Masked/contrastive pretraining and environmental/region-aware dynamic graphs model urban flows under spatial-temporal heterogeneity, tested on real transport datasets.
139: A memristive Hopfield dynamical system supplies chaotic attractors for video encryption and is implemented on hardware. The abstract does not establish a learned AI inference/training role in the research method.
142: An interval type-3 fuzzy inference system approximates unknown nonlinear functions within a prescribed-time controller for coupled Duffing MEMS resonators, directly addressing physical device dynamics and control. Do not label as a neural network or invent training details.
144: Actual spiking neuron-astrocyte neuromorphic hardware emulates multi-item working memory and recall timing/noise. Need inspect necessary original methods to distinguish implemented inferential/learning model of memory from generic hardware demonstration.
154: A neural estimator of extreme expected shortfall/conditional tail moments is developed with extreme-value convergence theory and validated on heavy-tail simulations and cryptocurrency extreme-loss data.
164: Actor-critic reinforcement learning optimizes voice-coil/piezo-actuator forces and vibration suppression in a macro-micro composite positioning stage under mechanical coupling.
166: Separable integral layers improve generic CNN deployment/parameter cost on ImageNet; continuous integral operations do not establish scientific equation solving or another science-domain application.

This supports actual adaptive learning in a scientific control task beyond merely studying a neural dynamical object. No claim of a specific deep architecture or clinical validation.
